calcul.question: How is my property valuation calculated?
calcul.reponse: We compare your property with sales actually recorded by the French State (DVF database) in your neighbourhood: same property type, similar surface area, sales less than 30 months old. The resulting price per m² is then adjusted for condition, energy rating (DPE), floor, outdoor space and parking. For rentals, we use the ANIL reference rents for your town.

fiable.question: Is the online valuation reliable?
fiable.reponse: It is based on actual transactions, not listings. The displayed range reflects the diversity of sales in your area. To turn this range into a precise asking price, an on-site appraisal remains essential: {agent} offers it to you, with no obligation.

gratuit.question: Is it really free and with no obligation?
gratuit.reponse: Yes. The valuation is free, instant and carries no obligation whatsoever. You are only contacted with your explicit consent, and your data is never sold.

avisValeur.question: What is the difference between an online valuation and an appraisal?
avisValeur.reponse: The online valuation gives an instant statistical range based on comparable sales. The appraisal is carried out on site by a professional: it takes into account what the data cannot show (view, layout, renovation work, co-ownership) and leads to a marketing price.

loyer.question: Can I estimate a rent?
loyer.reponse: Yes. The same form estimates the monthly rent of your flat or house from the official ANIL indicators for your town, including DPE regulatory alerts (the progressive ban on renting energy-inefficient homes).
